family.description: This family of uncharacterised proteins is found in bacteria (Bacteroidota and Chloroflexi). Proteins in this family are approximately 80 amino acids in length. The proteins are likely to be integral membrane proteins with two transmembrane alpha helices. Structural modelling suggests that these proteins form a dimeric arrangement with the pairs of alpha helices tilted at close to 45 degrees angle compared to the lipid membrane. Based on the positive inside rule it is likely that the N and C-terminii of the proteins have a cytoplasmic location. Given the geometry of the protein complex it may not span the entire membrane.
family.name: Family of unknown function (DUF7672)
